changelog.text:
[中文](#cn-v0.2.2-rc.5) | [English](#en-v0.2.2-rc.5)

体验优化

- DeepSeek 模型使用 DeepSeek 服务端搜索，搜索不按次收费；其他模型默认使用 DeepSeek Search API。 @LegGasai

Improvements

- DeepSeek models use DeepSeek server-side search with no per-search charge; other models default to DeepSeek Search API. by @LegGasai Full Changelog: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.2-rc.4...dsh-v0.2.2-rc.5

changes.title: Model parameter dsh_session_log.events.7.data.message.content.0.text: none → none
changes.text_diff:
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@
 
 Check the [exit code: N] marker on every bash result; investigate failures before moving on.
 
-Use the read tool — not shell commands like cat — to inspect text files. Use offset and limit to continue reading large files.
+Use the read tool — not shell commands like cat, sed, head, or tail — to inspect text files. Use offset and limit to read a line range or continue a large file.
 
 Read an existing file before overwriting it with write and prefer edit for targeted changes.
 
@@ -30,4 +30,8 @@
 Use the workflow tool ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a workflow or for large multi-agent orchestration: you write a JavaScript script (the tool description documents the exact format) that fans work out across many subagents with phases and structured results.
 For one or two delegations, prefer plain subagent calls.
 
-Start independent delegations with `subagent` or `subagent_fork` together in one assistant message and continue useful work while they run. When only waiting for their results remains, end your turn instead of sleeping or polling; the next result starts a new turn.
+Start independent delegations with `subagent` or `subagent_fork` together in one assistant message and continue useful work while they run.
+When only waiting for their results remains, end your turn instead of sleeping or polling; the next result starts a new turn.
+Collect the subagent results required to complete the task before giving the user a final answer.
+
+Bash, formatters, code generators, and scripts can overwrite concurrent edits without conflict detection; coordinate their changes explicitly. The agent integrating the work must review the final diff and run relevant tests.

changes.title: Model parameter dsh_session_log.events.10.data.header.tools.list_agents.description: none → none
changes.text_diff:
@@ -1,1 +1,8 @@
-List subagents you started, with their ids, labels, and status. running means it is working; inactive means it is not currently working. You will be notified when a subagent finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.
+List your entire subagent tree: the root agent and all reachable continuable descendants, including yourself.
+Rows carry names, descriptions, and status.
+A descendant's name is its path from the root, such as reviewer/checker.
+You can message any other agent in the subagent tree.
+running means it is working; inactive means no turn is executing; it does not indicate task completion, success, or failure.
+corrupt, unsupported, or unavailable means this row's own descendants could not be read; the row itself is still a member you can message.
+While you remain active, you will be notified when a direct child finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status.
+Use send_message to continue the conversation.

changes.title: Model parameter dsh_session_log.events.10.data.header.tools.subagent.description: none → none
changes.text_diff:
@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context.
 The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps.
-This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id.
-The runtime notifies you when it finishes.
-The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.
+This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its name.
+If you are still online when it finishes, the runtime automatically delivers its completion notice.
+The notice includes the final answer unless the child sent you a message just before finishing.
+Use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.
